Reaction colour and label = pFBA flux (mmol/gDW/h) on Task A medium + PO1f, Gurobi 1e-9; grey = 0. Scenario 'census': amber = freed in the open condition only, pink = freed on Task A only, blue = freed in both.

Node colour (open census): blue = gap metabolite under a1237821 and not under 00e8e397; orange = gap under both; grey = not a gap. Repeated nodes are the same pool. Layout is automatic and carries no biological meaning.
BEFORE: a1237821 (a12378210c7c6672...), pFBA on Task A + PO1f. Grey = no flux; no freed reaction carries flux. biomass_C (light grey) lacks these six terms here
